standard_prerequisites.name: Maps from a perfect complex into any complex are computed as the degree zero cohomology of the tensor with the dual perfect complex
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the Hom vanishing into a cohomology vanishing for a tensor product.

standard_prerequisites.name: The tensor product of the dual with L has cohomology controlled by the spectral sequence from the tor amplitude of the dual and the cohomology sheaves of L
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows the cohomology of the tensor vanishes in a range when L has a cohomological gap.

standard_prerequisites.name: On a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme the degree zero cohomology depends only on a finite stretch of cohomology sheaves, controlled by the number of affines needed for a cover
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the vanishing of a finite range of cohomology sheaves force the vanishing of H^0.

core_obligations: Part (2) follows from (1) since Ext^n(K, L) = Hom(K, L[n]) (proof lines 3477-3481).

Rewrite Hom(K, L) = H^0(X, K^dual tensor^L L) using the dual perfect complex (Cohomology, Lemma dual-perfect-complex); the tensor lies in D_QCoh by Lemmas quasi-coherence-tensor-product and pseudo-coherent (perfect complexes have quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves); say K^dual has tor amplitude in [a, b] (proof lines 3483-3493).
The spectral sequence E_1^{p,q} = H^p(K^dual tensor H^q(L)) ⇒ H^{p+q}(K^dual tensor^L L) shows H^j of the tensor vanishes whenever H^q(L) = 0 for q in [j - b, j - a] (proof lines 3494-3500).

Let N be the integer of Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma vanishing-nr-affines-quasi-separated; by that lemma and Lemma application-nice-K-injective, H^0(X, K^dual tensor^L L) = H^0(X, tau_{>= -N}(...)) and, when the sheaves H^{-N} through H^0 of the tensor vanish, this equals H^0(X, tau_{>= 1}(...)) which is zero by Derived Categories, Lemma negative-vanishing; hence Hom(K, L) = 0 whenever H^i(L) = 0 for i in [-b - N, -a], proving (1) (proof lines 3502-3522).
proof_roadmap: Rewrite Hom via the dual and identify the tor amplitude of the dual (proof lines 3483-3493).
Control the cohomology of the tensor by the spectral sequence (proof lines 3494-3500).
Force H^0 to vanish via the finite cohomological range and negative vanishing (proof lines 3502-3522).
